P14 9 deceased sentence, no-contact/deceased

P14 12 + M44 A 4 wrong answers total; wrong_answers_left
P14 13 failed instruction, id-fail/exhausted
P14 14 explain once, second refusal id-fail/would-not-answer

P14 17 next/this weekday

P14 22 + M44 B band2 24-60 today+9 calendar days, previous business day, 2 attempts
